claims.label: Ben Shapiro Demanded Candace Owens Be Called Out by Name at AmFest
claims.claim: At AmFest, Ben Shapiro stated that Candace Owens was casting aspersions on TPUSA staff and on Erika Kirk, and that people with microphones had a moral obligation to call her out by name.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the full unedited AmFest video and timestamp; verify whether Shapiro named specific TPUSA staff (Mikey McCormick, Andrew Colvin, Blake Neff, Tyler Bowyer, Erika Kirk) and the precise wording.

claims.label: Tucker Carlson Stated Charlie Kirk Faced Donor Pressure to Remove Him From AmFest Roster
claims.claim: Tucker Carlson stated at AmFest that during the last several months of Charlie Kirk's life, donors to Turning Point – whom Carlson attributed in part to Ben Shapiro's insistence – pressured Kirk to remove Tucker from the AmFest speaker roster.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the full unedited Carlson speech; verify the specific donor names and corroborate through contemporaneous TPUSA communications.

claims.label: Daily Wire Held a Town Hall–Style Firing Event for Candace Owens with Ben Shapiro Appearing Electronically
claims.claim: The Daily Wire held a "town hall"–style firing event attended by approximately 300 employees in which then-CEO Jeremy Boreing narrated a packaged presentation of Owens's X posts (October 28, 2023 protest repost; November 3, 2023 genocide tweet; pornography tweet; "Christ is King" tweets), with Ben Shapiro joining electronically on screen.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the full leaked town hall video; verify the exact date, attendance count, and the specific X posts cited as grounds.

claims.label: Mark Amodei Publicly Claimed a 12-House-Floor Alibi for September 9
claims.claim: Mark Amodei publicly asserted via X that on September 9 he was in a 12-hour House Appropriations Committee meeting and voting on the House floor, citing the public record.
claims.investigative_direction: Retrieve the original X post URL; cross-reference with the House Appropriations Committee's published September 9 video and the House roll call record.

claims.label: Mark Amodei Missed Two Morning Roll Calls on September 9
claims.claim: Per Diligent Dennison's X post analysis, Mark Amodei was not present for roll call until the third meeting in mid-afternoon on September 9 in D.C., having missed two morning roll calls.
claims.investigative_direction: Independently verify against the official House roll call vote record for September 9, 2025; verify flight routing feasibility for Amodei to have been at Fort Huachuca that morning and back in D.C. for the third roll call.

claims.label: Mitch Identified Cabot Phillips from a Photograph as a Person Seen at Fort Huachuca
claims.claim: After being shown a photograph of Cabot Phillips without contextual identification, Mitch identified him as a person he observed at Fort Huachuca on the morning of September 9.
claims.investigative_direction: Corroborate through independent identification sources; verify Cabot Phillips's whereabouts between September 4 and 10, 2025 (including Morning Wire appearance records); await response from Cabot Phillips to host's outreach.

claims.label: Brian Harpole's Travel Logs Permit Attendance at the Fort Huachuca Morning Meeting
claims.claim: Travel logs provided to the host indicate that Brian Harpole's flight routing would have allowed him to attend the early-morning Fort Huachuca meeting on September 9.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain or display the actual travel logs; corroborate against airline / charter records; await response from Brian Harpole to host's iMessage outreach.

claims.label: Mitch's Base Access, Hotel Booking, and NDA Paperwork Have Been Independently Verified
claims.claim: The host reports that Mitch's reported access to Fort Huachuca base, his hotel booking at Candlewood Inn & Suites, and his NDA-related lawsuit paperwork have all been verified by the host's team.
claims.investigative_direction: Display or publish the underlying verification documents; obtain third-party corroboration beyond host's assertions.

claims.label: Erika Kirk Reportedly Claimed She Had Not Dated Anyone Before Charlie Kirk
claims.claim: The host reports that Erika Kirk publicly stated she had not dated anyone before Charlie Kirk, which the host characterizes as contradicting social-media evidence of a prior relationship with Cabot Phillips and his family.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the original Erika Kirk statement (interview, podcast, or social-media post); obtain screenshots of the cited social-media evidence (painting lessons, family interactions); obtain corroboration from family members including Nicole Rothstein.

claims.label: Host grows more certain Israel might be involved in 9/10
claims.claim: The host says that every time Ben Shapiro speaks she grows more certain that Israel might be involved with 9/10.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify what evidence, beyond Shapiro's reaction, the host relies on; ask the host to specify what 'involved' means and what record would support it.
claims.transcript_snippet: every time he speaks, I grow more certain that Israel might be involved with 9/10.

claims.label: Shapiro was absent from AmFest lists for years and returned in 2024
claims.claim: The host says people noticed Ben Shapiro was not on the AmFest speaker list for years and is back on it beginning in 2024, and that she will explain how that happened.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare archived AmFest speaker lists for 2019 to 2025 to confirm the years Shapiro was or was not listed.
claims.transcript_snippet: some people noticed that he wasn't on the AmFest list for years and all of a sudden he's back on the speaker list beginning in 2024.

claims.label: Host says Shapiro sent an intern to ask her a question on stage in Dallas
claims.claim: The host says she learned, while about to speak in Dallas at the YWLS convention, that Ben Shapiro had sent an intern to ask her a question on stage, and that she called him out on stage.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the host's earlier-episode evidence on the YWLS intern and any Daily Wire or YWLS record of the intern's role.
claims.transcript_snippet: as I was going to speak in Dallas at their YWLS convention that Ben had sent an intern who was going to ask me a question while I was on stage.

claims.label: Host says Shapiro had Jewish donors threaten Charlie Kirk over her speaking slot
claims.claim: The host says Ben Shapiro worked behind the scenes to have Jewish donors threaten Charlie Kirk so that she would not be invited to speak at year end, and that this is what Charlie told her.
claims.investigative_direction: Seek Charlie Kirk's own messages or contemporaneous accounts naming the donors and the request; ask Shapiro or TPUSA to confirm or deny.
claims.transcript_snippet: he began working behind the scenes to have Jewish donors start threatening Charlie to make sure that I wasn't invited to speak at year end

claims.label: Host says Kolvet told her Shapiro would spend an offensive amount to be part of AmFest
claims.claim: The host says Andrew Kolvet told her directly that Ben Shapiro was willing to spend an offensive amount of money to be a part of AmFest.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain TPUSA sponsorship and advertising records for AmFest 2024; ask Kolvet to confirm or deny the conversation.
claims.transcript_snippet: this is what was divulged to me from Andrew Kolb at the time, willing to spend an offensive amount of money to be a part of AmFest.

claims.label: Host says Shapiro worked with Barry Weiss on an article that donors want her gone
claims.claim: The host says she knew Ben Shapiro was working with Barry Weiss to put out an article saying the donors and board of TPUSA wanted Candace gone.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the Free Press or other article the host refers to and any TPUSA board or donor statement quoted in it.
claims.transcript_snippet: he was working with Barry Weiss to call and put an article out saying that the donors, the people on the board of TPUSA want Candace gone.

claims.label: Brian Mast wore an IDF uniform in Congress and said there is no innocent Palestinian life
claims.claim: The host says Brian Mast wore an IDF uniform in Congress and said, in her words, that there is no such thing as an innocent Palestinian life.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the original Mast remarks and the Yashar Ali post that shared them, with dates, to check the host's paraphrase.
claims.transcript_snippet: Brian Mast had was wearing an IDF uniform in Congress and he basically said that there's no such thing as an innocent Palestinian life.

claims.label: Host tweeted that genocidal language is always wrong in response to Yashar Ali's post
claims.claim: The host says that when she saw the Mast remarks shared by Yashar Ali on X, she responded that genocidal language, no matter who shares it, is always wrong.
claims.investigative_direction: Retrieve the host's reply tweet from November 2023 and compare its wording with the host's account and with Boreing's quoted tweets.
claims.transcript_snippet: I responded and I said that genocidal language, no matter who shares it, is always wrong.

claims.label: Host says Shapiro was caught on video standing on a table insulting her
claims.claim: The host says someone caught Ben Shapiro standing on a table at a private event insulting her over her tweet that genocide is always wrong, and plays the audio.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the original recording, its date and venue, and who captured and leaked it.
claims.transcript_snippet: somebody caught him standing on a table insulting me over my genocide is always wrong tweet.

claims.label: In the clip Shapiro calls the host disgraceful and says she works at his company
claims.claim: In the replayed audio, a speaker the host identifies as Ben Shapiro calls the host's behavior disgraceful and disreputable and says she works at his company.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the full original recording to confirm the speaker, the date and the exact wording.
claims.transcript_snippet: Disreputable, disgraceful, she works at my company.

claims.label: The table clip leaked on the morning of November 14 when the host was six days from giving birth
claims.claim: The host says the clip leaked on the morning of November 14 and that she was 6 days away from giving birth.
claims.investigative_direction: Check the clip's first public posting time against the host's account and her child's birth date.
claims.transcript_snippet: that was on the morning of November 14th. I was 6 days away from giving birth.

claims.label: Host says nobody at the Daily Wire stepped in after the clip leaked
claims.claim: The host says that when the clip leaked, nobody from the Daily Wire stepped in to manage the situation while journalists contacted her for comment.
claims.investigative_direction: Seek contemporaneous Daily Wire communications to the host on November 14, 2023 and any public statement the company issued.
claims.transcript_snippet: Nobody from the Daily Wire steps in to manage the situation.

claims.label: Host says her husband told her to read the Sermon on the Mount and she tweeted 'blessed are the peacemakers'
claims.claim: The host says her husband advised her to read the Sermon on the Mount rather than respond to the clip, and that she tweeted 'blessed are the peacemakers' and ended with 'Christ is king'.
claims.investigative_direction: Retrieve the host's tweet from mid-November 2023 and confirm its text and timestamp.
claims.transcript_snippet: I tweeted blessed are the peacemakers.

claims.label: Tucker Carlson booked the host six weeks earlier for November 15 with Daily Wire approval
claims.claim: The host says Tucker Carlson had booked her about six weeks earlier for an interview on November 15, and that she had Daily Wire approval.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the booking correspondence and the Daily Wire approval; confirm the interview's recording and release dates.
claims.transcript_snippet: He had booked me 6 weeks earlier. I got approval from Daily Wire. He booked me for November 15th.

claims.label: Host told Tucker Carlson she was obsessed with Thomas Sowell
claims.claim: In the replayed interview clip, the host tells Tucker Carlson she has been obsessed with Thomas Sowell and is a groupie of his work.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the full Tucker Carlson interview of November 2023 and confirm the exchange and its date.
claims.transcript_snippet: You know, I have been obsessed with Thomas Sowell.

claims.label: Host alleges Shapiro's team arranged a paid interview with Thomas Sowell to hurt her
claims.claim: The host alleges that after seeing her Sowell answer, Ben Shapiro had his team schedule an interview with Thomas Sowell, which she presumes they paid an offensive amount for, in order to hurt her feelings.
claims.investigative_direction: Find the Daily Wire's Sowell interview release date and any payment or booking records; ask Daily Wire about the motive the host alleges.
claims.transcript_snippet: Ben had his team reach out and schedule an interview with Thomas Sowell which they paid for an offensive amount of money

claims.label: Host says the Sowell interview premiered right alongside her Tucker Carlson interview
claims.claim: The host says her Tucker Carlson interview was on the 15th and premiered on the 16th, and that Ben then got a Thomas Sowell interview out at the same time.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare the publication timestamps of the Carlson interview and the Daily Wire's Sowell interview.
claims.transcript_snippet: Interview with Tucker is on the 15th. I think it premieres on the 16th. And Ben gets Thomas Sowell who he doesn't care about.

claims.label: Host says a stage was built in her studio and clips prepared for her firing
claims.claim: The host says that after her show, without knowing she would be fired, the company had put together a stage in her studio and a package of clips about her.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the leaked town hall video and any Daily Wire staff accounts of the setup and the timing relative to her show.
claims.transcript_snippet: they had put together a stage in my studio and put up clips of put together basically a whole package

claims.label: Steven Crowder obtained the town hall video
claims.claim: The host says Steven Crowder somehow got hold of the Jeremy Boreing town hall video this week or last week.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate Crowder's release of the video and the date it was posted; ask Crowder for the source.
claims.transcript_snippet: somehow Steven Crowder got a a hold of this week or last week or whatever.

claims.label: Boreing says Dave Rubin rebuked her tweet and she attacked him in response
claims.claim: In the replayed town hall video, Jeremy Boreing says Dave Rubin came to the same conclusion as anti-Semites about her genocide tweet but found it vile and rebuked her, and that she then attacked him.
claims.investigative_direction: Retrieve the Rubin and host exchange on X from November 2023 and compare with Boreing's quoted text.
claims.transcript_snippet: So when Dave Rubin came to the exact same conclusion as the anti-Semites only instead of cheering for Candace found it vile and rebuked her

claims.label: Boreing says the host liked a post calling Netanyahu a war criminal within 24 hours
claims.claim: In the replayed town hall video, Jeremy Boreing says that within 24 hours the host liked a post calling Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu a war criminal.
claims.investigative_direction: Check the host's X likes history or archived copies for the November 2023 like cited by Boreing.
claims.transcript_snippet: Within 24 hours Candace liked a post calling Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu a war criminal.

claims.label: Boreing says replies to her pornography tweet were flooded with cheering anti-Semites
claims.claim: In the replayed town hall video, Jeremy Boreing says replies to the host's February 28, 2024 post were immediately flooded with anti-Semites cheering her for the question.
claims.investigative_direction: Review archived replies to the February 28, 2024 post to test the characterization.
claims.transcript_snippet: Her replies were immediately flooded with anti-Semites cheering her for the question

claims.label: Host says she stands by the tweets cited in the town hall
claims.claim: The host says she stands by all of the tweets Boreing cited and that pornography is harming men.
claims.investigative_direction: No further verification beyond matching the position to her original tweets.
claims.transcript_snippet: I stand by all of those tweets. Pornography is harming men.

claims.label: Host says she spoke to Nick Fuentes only once, about Kanye
claims.claim: The host says Boreing's presentation showed videos of Nick Fuentes unrelated to her, and that she has spoken to Fuentes only once, about Kanye.
claims.investigative_direction: Check the host's prior statements and any call or message records about contacts with Fuentes; review the Boreing video for the Fuentes segment.
claims.transcript_snippet: I think only one time I'd spoken ever to Nick Fuentes. And it was pertaining to Kanye.

claims.label: Host says Shapiro has brought three court proceedings against her
claims.claim: The host says Ben Shapiro has issued, so far, three court proceedings against her over what she says.
claims.investigative_direction: Search state and federal dockets for cases between the host and Ben Shapiro or the Daily Wire and list them.
claims.transcript_snippet: He has issued thus far three court proceedings, okay?

claims.label: Host says Shapiro's side contacted advertisers and sent undercover interns
claims.claim: The host says people working for Ben Shapiro have called her advertisers to try to bankrupt her in court and have sent undercover interns to stalk her.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain advertiser communications and the intern evidence; ask Daily Wire to respond.
claims.transcript_snippet: people working behind the scenes to call advertisers attempting to bankrupt me in courts sending undercover interns to stalk me.

claims.label: Host says Shapiro sued her over an interview with a USS Liberty survivor
claims.claim: The host says Ben Shapiro sued her because she interviewed a USS Liberty survivor who mentioned his name.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the complaint and the interview episode it refers to and compare the pleaded basis with the host's account.
claims.transcript_snippet: I have put up with the pettiness of even suing me because I interviewed a USS Liberty survivor who mentioned your name

claims.label: Host says Shapiro buys his place with advertising spend
claims.claim: Addressing Shapiro, the host alleges that he gets donors to pressure people or offers an advertising spend, with a line she renders as 'Here's a million dollars. I'm sorry you're dead.'
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain TPUSA sponsorship records and any Daily Wire spend on Turning Point events or Charlie Kirk's show; note the line is the host's paraphrase.
claims.transcript_snippet: Here's a million dollars. I'm sorry you're dead.

claims.label: Host alleges Shapiro's AmFest audience was staffed with YAF employees told to cheer
claims.claim: The host alleges that audiences for Shapiro are staffed with people who work for Young America's Foundation, told to explode into cheers when he hits the stage.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain any YAF or TPUSA staff instructions for the AmFest session and interview attendees; compare with video of the crowd response.
claims.transcript_snippet: You staff audiences with people that work for YAF who are told to explode into cheers when you hit the stage

claims.label: Shapiro's speech says the host implicated French intelligence, Mossad and TPUSA members
claims.claim: In the AmFest audio, Ben Shapiro says the host has spewed baseless trash implicating everyone from French intelligence to Mossad to members of TPUSA in Charlie Kirk's murder or a cover-up.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare against the host's own episodes to see who she has actually named, and obtain the full speech.
claims.transcript_snippet: to spew absolutely baseless trash implicating everyone from French intelligence to Mossad to members of TPUSA in Charlie's murder or a cover-up in that murder

claims.label: Shapiro's speech also faulted Tucker Carlson and Megyn Kelly for not condemning the host
claims.claim: In the AmFest audio, Ben Shapiro says Megyn Kelly, whom he calls a friend, is shying away from condemning the host by calling her a young mother, and tells Tucker Carlson that going silent on her is no excuse.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the full speech video to confirm wording and the passages naming Carlson and Kelly.
claims.transcript_snippet: The same holds true of Megan Kelly, a person I consider a friend, characterizing Candace as a young mother and thus shying away from condemning her actions

claims.label: Host says AmFest kids booed Shapiro and TPUSA people messaged her about it
claims.claim: The host says the AmFest attendees booed Shapiro on stage and that she received many messages from Turning Point USA people asking why he was on the stage.
claims.investigative_direction: Review full AmFest session video for audience reaction; ask the host for the messages she describes.
claims.transcript_snippet: you know those kids booed you on that stage, the amount of messages I got from Turning Point USA people saying what is happening

claims.label: Host says Shapiro describes himself as a Talmudic Jew
claims.claim: The host says Ben Shapiro describes himself as a Talmudic Jew.
claims.investigative_direction: Find Shapiro's own statements using that phrase and their dates.
claims.transcript_snippet: You describe yourself as a Talmudic Jew and I've learned what's in that Talmud

claims.label: Host asserts the Talmud teaches that Jews have a right to own, deceive and sue non-Jews
claims.claim: The host asserts that, according to the Talmud, Jewish people think non-Jews are animals and have a right to own them, make them worship, lie to them and sue them. She cites no passage.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask the host for the specific Talmudic passages; compare with the primary texts and mainstream scholarly translations and commentary. This is a sweeping religious characterization, not a record of Shapiro's conduct.
claims.transcript_snippet: they think that we're animals. That they have a right to own us. That they have a right to make us worship them.

claims.label: Host says Shapiro's father writes under the pen name Hank Berrien
claims.claim: The host says Ben Shapiro's father writes articles for the Daily Wire under the pen name Hank Berrien, as he did while Ben was at Breitbart.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare Hank Berrien bylines at Breitbart and the Daily Wire with public statements by Shapiro or his father about the name.
claims.transcript_snippet: How many more articles is his father going to write under a pen name, Hank Berrien of the Daily Wire, under the pen name, Hank Berrien, as he wrote while Ben was at Breitbart

claims.label: Host says Jewish donors pressured Charlie Kirk, some because Shapiro insisted
claims.claim: The host says Charlie Kirk fought to the end against Jewish donors who were pressuring him, some of them because Ben Shapiro insisted that they do so.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the donors and any communications between them and Shapiro or Charlie Kirk's team; separate this from Carlson's own statement, which does not name Shapiro as a cause.
claims.transcript_snippet: who he fought for till the very end against the Jewish donors who were pressuring him, some of them because Ben Shapiro insisted that they do.

claims.label: Host asserts Jewish people controlled the slave trade
claims.claim: The host asserts that Jewish people were the ones trading enslaved Black people and were in control of the slave trade.
